A course-approved claim for 100 non-transferable demo points. This is not MON, money, an NFT or a $5 course credit. Waiting behind traffic should never count against eligibility.

2 · COURSE APPROVAL

Approval comes before the reward.

Contract owner not checked.

The contract owner approves the selected golfer and round. For a one-wallet presentation, the deployer can approve their own wallet; this demonstrates the transaction flow, not independent course verification.

Course staff must review the round. No automatic eligibility is inferred from demo GPS or a wallet connection.

Course setup: deploy a demo contract

Deploys the included testnet-only contract from your connected wallet, which becomes its owner. No MON is deposited or paid out; testnet gas is required. Use a separate test wallet. Do not enter a seed phrase or private key anywhere.

3 · GOLFER CLAIM

A claim you can verify.

The approved golfer claims once for this round. A successful receipt adds 100 demo points in this contract. The contract prevents duplicate claims for the same wallet and round.

No transaction sent.

What this proves—and what comes next

This demonstrates owner approval, a golfer claim, duplicate protection and an on-chain points record. Phone locations and traffic calculations stay off-chain. Local demo completion does not automatically establish reward eligibility.

A real course pilot still needs verified round records, staff authorization, traffic-adjusted eligibility, abuse controls, reviewed contracts and course funding before any redeemable credit.
